## Dependency direction and ownership

<!-- agent-engineering:judgment:architecture-boundaries:start -->
### The shape

Three layers in the repository, four planes at runtime.

| Layer | Path | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Shipped skills | `skills/*/` | Self-contained. Everything a skill needs at runtime lives in its own directory. OBSERVED `AGENTS.md:33` |
| Enforcement | `hooks/` | Loaded only where the kit is installed as a plugin. OBSERVED `hooks/hooks.json:1` |
| Repo tooling | `scripts/` | Validation and acceptance tests. Never shipped inside a skill. OBSERVED `AGENTS.md:31` |
| Eval material | `evals/` | Golden routing cases plus a planted-defect fixture. Not packaged. OBSERVED `AGENTS.md:32` |

At runtime the kit operates on four planes:

| Plane | Artifact | Committed? |
|---|---|---|
| Instruction | 8 x `SKILL.md`, `references/roles/*`, `references/lenses/*` | yes (shipped) |
| Enforcement | `hooks/hooks.json` → `skills/ae-forge/scripts/guard.mjs` | yes; active only on the plugin path |
| Control | `forge.mjs` gates, `team.json`, `.dev/work/<id>/run.json` | `run.json` **is** committed; the rest of `work/` is not |
| Content | `.dev/runs/<id>.md`, `results/<role>.md`, `brief.md` | artifact and brief yes, results no |

### Two coupling styles, both now documented

1. Across the **product** boundary (`ae-forge` ↔ `ae-surveyor`) the channel is an artifact in the target project, never a cross-skill file read. It is versioned: `analysis.json` carries `schema`, `team.json` declares the version it expects at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/references/team.json:3`, and `lens-select.mjs` compares them at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/lens-select.mjs:169`. A foreign schema is now **reported** as `schema_mismatch` rather than silently yielding fewer lenses.
2. Within the **delivery pipeline**, the six stage skills resolve `ae-forge` as a sibling and read its `references/`. OBSERVED `skills/ae-plan/SKILL.md:27`. They are one distribution unit with `ae-forge`, versioned together by `contract`. The distinction is stated at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/references/team.md:116`.

### Who owns what

| Concern | Owner | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Routing, tiers, roles, lenses, acceptance | `references/team.json` | OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/references/team.json:1` |
| Every gate that can refuse when called | `scripts/forge.mjs` | OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:18` |
| The two gates that refuse without being called | `scripts/guard.mjs` | OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/guard.mjs:89` |
| Role method (does not rot) | `references/roles/*.md` | OBSERVED `AGENTS.md:82` |
| Dated domain facts (rots; carries `verified:`) | `references/lenses/*.md` | OBSERVED `AGENTS.md:81` |
| Repository sensing | `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/sense.mjs` | OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/sense.mjs:110` |
| Markdown rendering and managed blocks | `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/artifact-support.mjs` | OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/artifact-support.mjs:38` |

**Forge is the sole coordinator.** Stages return to Forge and never invoke one another; only Builder edits application code. Stages run sequentially by doctrine because plan/review and build/verify are adversarial pairs. OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/SKILL.md:189`.

### Authority is enforced four ways, and the orderings are checked

**ownership** (one role per artifact section, OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:143`), **ordering** (OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:18` and `:491`), **completion** (four nameable gaps, OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:820`), and **enforcement** (OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/guard.mjs:89`).

Stage ordering is encoded in four tables plus each stage skill's read-list. `forge.mjs contract` prints all four (OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:1319`) and `validate-forge.mjs` reads them back, asserting that every phase a role is gated to is reachable from `understand`, that section ownership and role gating agree, that no role owns two sections, and that each stage skill writes the section its role owns.

### One event, one write

`note` now places the artifact section its role owns when that section is still scaffolded. OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:723`. An already-written section is never overwritten, so the explicit `section` call stays first in every stage skill and remains the way to place a body that is not the whole result file. `finish`'s `sections` gap is retained as a net, but forgetting can no longer trip it.

### Self-hosting

The surveyor's premise — `skills/ae-*/` is an installed dependency — is false in this repository, where it is the product. `ae_self_hosted` (OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/lib.sh:183`) detects the kit's own source tree; `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/scaffold.sh:189` then omits the suite ignore rule, and `doctor.sh` suppresses the untrack advice and the lock warning at `:141`, `:169` and `:179`.
